name: Kitaku Shoujo no Sasoikata
source:
Makito and Miku first met at the park.
He was an otaku who lived in a run-down apartment nearby, just sitting on the bench.
She was walking home from school. Little by little they came to know each other.

Miku was a fan of magical girl anime.
However it seemed that her parents were very strict and wouldn't let her watch at home.

"I record everything. Would you like to watch at my house?"

She eagerly accepted the invitation to his bedroom.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE128539.html]DLsite English[/url]]
